name: race_offline_outcome_time_lost
description: An offline race lost on time ends lost, though my hollow cleared all its waves (design 1.3: the lower race time wins, and every life lost adds a minute (10 s before M8); review of M6: main.gd called this won because my hollow was done). Racing the caretaker, my hollow clears wave 12 first but with fifteen lives lost, so its race time carries 900 s (150 s before M8); nothing is decided while the mirror can still beat it. The mirror clears wave 12 later with a lower race time, SimMatch.outcomes() says lost for my team, and the results say 'Your Rival Outran the Tide' with the rule: fewer lives lost.

steps.assert: Game.sim.race_time(0) == Game.sim.teams[0].clear_tick + 54000 and Game.outcome() == '' and not Game.sim.over
steps.msg: my hollow cleared wave 12, but 900 s of lost lives leave the mirror time to beat it
no end plate while the race goes on

steps.assert: Game.sim.decided_by() == 'time' and Game.sim.race_time(1) >= 0 and Game.sim.race_time(1) < Game.sim.race_time(0) and Game.sim.outcomes()[0] == 1 and Game.outcome() == 'lost'
steps.msg: the mirror's race time is the lower: the simulation decided the race against my team

steps.assert: node('ResultsPanel').results['outcome'] == 'lost' and node('ResultsTitle').text == 'YOUR RIVAL OUTRAN THE TIDE' and node('ResultsRule').text == "Fewer lives lost: your rival's race time is the lower"
steps.msg: and the results say lost, with the rule
my crew's race time with its 900 s
